blocking_issues.title: API Field Name Mismatch: hourly_rate_eur_cents
blocking_issues.impact: Time entry form submission will fail — field name mismatch in deserialization
blocking_issues.remediation: Option 1: Add response mapping in backend (recommended). Option 2: Update frontend types to 'billable_rate_eur_cents'.

blocking_issues.title: API Field Name Mismatch: party_id vs bill_to_party_id
blocking_issues.impact: Invoice display and party selection will fail
blocking_issues.remediation: Option 1: Add response mapping in backend (recommended). Option 2: Update frontend types to 'bill_to_party_id'.

blocking_issues.title: API Structural Mismatch: Invoice Lines
blocking_issues.description: Frontend expects {time_entry_id, expense_id}, backend returns {source_type, source_id}
blocking_issues.impact: Invoice line display will break — cannot identify line sources
blocking_issues.remediation: Option 1: Add mapper in backend (source_type=='time' → time_entry_id, etc). Option 2: Update frontend to parse source_type + source_id.

blocking_issues.title: Typecheck Failures (Pending)
blocking_issues.description: API and web typecheck builds are in progress and expected to fail due to schema mismatches
blocking_issues.remediation: Fix contract mismatches (B1-B3) then re-run typecheck

non_blocking_issues.title: Enum Mismatch: Expense Types
non_blocking_issues.remediation: Align frontend enum to backend (backend is more comprehensive)

non_blocking_issues.title: Enum Mismatch: Payment Methods
non_blocking_issues.description: Frontend includes 'card' and 'pos'; backend expects Greek payment gateway names ('viva', 'ethniki')

non_blocking_issues.title: Expense DELETE Behavior Unclear
non_blocking_issues.description: Comment says 'soft delete' but DELETE endpoint implementation not shown; schema has no soft_deleted_at column
non_blocking_issues.remediation: Clarify: Should expenses be soft-deleted (status-based) or hard-deleted? Implement accordingly.

non_blocking_issues.title: DRAFT Invoice Number Collision Risk
non_blocking_issues.description: Placeholder uses timestamp — if 2 parallel requests hit same millisecond for same party, UNIQUE constraint may fail
non_blocking_issues.remediation: Use UUID instead of timestamp: DRAFT-${crypto.randomUUID()}

non_blocking_issues.title: Invoice Status Enum Mismatch
non_blocking_issues.description: Frontend missing 'sent' state (backend adds it post-finalize); no support for 'partial' payment status
non_blocking_issues.remediation: Add 'sent' to frontend enum; add 'partial' logic to backend (mark partial if 0 < totalPaid < invoiceTotal)
